query:
SELECT DISTINCT mc.characterName, ms.name as setName, mc.frontImageUrl, mc.cardNumber, mc.subset
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
WHERE mc.characterName IN ('Doctor Doom', 'Thor', 'Captain America', 'Ant-Man', 'Spider-Man', 'Hulk', 'Iron Man', 'Wolverine', 'Cyclops', 'Gambit', 'Nightcrawler', 'Beast', 'Magneto', 'Invisible Woman', 'Human Torch', 'The Thing', 'Mr. Fantastic', 'Shang-Chi', 'Shuri', 'Loki', 'Captain Marvel', 'Hawkeye', 'Falcon', 'Ghost', 'Bucky Barnes', 'Yelena Belova', 'Sentry', 'Mighty Thor', 'Scott Lang', 'Sam Wilson')
AND mc.subset = 'Base'
ORDER BY mc.characterName
LIMIT 20;
